summary: Edna Quintana, 55, last seen May 3, 2023 while rock hunting on foot near County Road 46AA in the Saguache area; CBI issued an endangered missing alert May 17, 2023 (medical issues, concern for her health); extensive multi-agency search by the Saguache County Sheriff's Office and the Colorado Bureau of Investigation; remains found by a hiker in a remote area of Saguache County on June 17, 2025, recovered with CBI crime-scene analysts and two cadaver-dog teams, identified by the El Paso County Coroner on June 25, 2025; cause of death under investigation
responding_agency: Saguache County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Bureau of Investigation
notes: Row date is the last-seen date (2023-05-03, Wednesday). During the 2023 search, unrelated unidentified male skeletal remains were found ~2023-07-26 in the foothills west of Saguache Peak off CR 46AA (coroner case, not indexed).
